thalamic_glutamatergic_projection_neuron.label: thalamic excitatory neuron
thalamic_glutamatergic_projection_neuron.note: CL term is defined as an excitatory neuron with soma in the thalamic complex; proposed type is the projection/relay family, so treated as BROAD rather than EXACT. OLS4 output exposed no PMID/DOI definition xrefs.

pvt_glutamatergic_neuron.label: thalamic excitatory neuron
pvt_glutamatergic_neuron.note: Nucleus-specific subset of CL thalamic excitatory neuron; no PVT-specific CL term found.

anterior_thalamic_nucleus_excitatory_neu.label: thalamic excitatory neuron
anterior_thalamic_nucleus_excitatory_neu.note: Nucleus-specific subset of CL thalamic excitatory neuron; no ATN-specific CL term found.

dlgn_relay_neuron.label: thalamic excitatory neuron
dlgn_relay_neuron.note: Broad parent only. CL:4023187 'koniocellular cell' (LGN koniocellular-layer neuron, primate-oriented) is a RELATED candidate for the Calb1/Necab1 shell subpopulation, not the whole dLGN relay type.

dlgn_gabaergic_interneuron.note: No CL term found for LGN/thalamic GABAergic interneuron (searched thalamic GABAergic neuron, lateral geniculate nucleus neuron) — potential CL contribution

trn_gabaergic_neuron.note: No CL term found for thalamic reticular nucleus neuron — potential CL contribution

lgv_igl_gabaergic_neuron.note: No CL term found for LGv/IGL GABAergic neuron — potential CL contribution
